theme: Light theme preferred for ERP data density, with deep dark sidebar for contrast.

colors.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST for trust and precision.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use flat solid cards with 1px border. Hover states get shadow-md.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0 for cards and tables. Sharp and clean.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-md or rounded-lg maximum (6px - 8px) for a crisp professional feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-heavy areas. Use flat solid surfaces to prevent visual refraction of data.

components.buttons: Rounded-md. Primary buttons use Deep Green (#14532D) with pure white text. Hover state must translate-y-[-1px] with increased shadow.
components.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-lg), border color darkens.
components.tables: Muted gridlines, status chips for labels. Table headers must have uppercase tracking-widest text-xs.
components.forms_inputs: Use Shadcn Input/Select. Background white, border slate-200, focus ring is primary green (ring-green-900/20).
components.sidebar: Collapsible left sidebar. Dark background (#0f172a) with light text/icons for contrast.

grids.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (For Dashboards/Analytics). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).

spans.primary_chart: col-span-2 row-span-2 or col-span-3 (Main data view)
spans.list_feed: col-span-1 row-span-2 (Tall narrow lists like recent activities)

layouts.login_screen: Split screen layout. Left side: High-impact hero image of school architecture with gradient overlay. Right side: Clean, centered login form with logo.
layouts.dashboard: Persistent collapsible Left Sidebar + Top Header (minimal) + Main scrollable content area with generous padding (p-6 to p-8).

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must transition smoothly: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
motion.page_transitions: Staggered entrance animations for dashboard cards and list items.
motion.loading_states: Skeleton loaders for data components before they populate.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. No light gray text on white.
accessibility.focus: All actionable items must have explicit focus states (focus:ring-2).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

media.icons: Use lucide-react (already installed). Phosphor-icons allowed if extra polish is needed.
media.images: Use realistic portraits for profiles, real modern school architecture for login.

login_hero_background.description: Modernist architecture for the universal login screen background.

login_hero_alt.description: Alternative clean white concrete school building.

avatar_placeholder_1.description: Professional female teacher portrait for dashboard profile.

avatar_placeholder_2.description: Professional male portrait for Founder/Admin profile.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Outfit and IBM Plex Sans.
Use Shadcn UI components for standard elements: cards, tables, forms, modals, tabs, dropdowns, sonner.
Build the dashboard layout with a collapsible sidebar and a clean top nav.
Implement the login page with a split layout (image on one side, form on the other).
Ensure strict role-based rendering is mocked/handled smoothly (show different dashboard views based on selected role).
Use Recharts (Shadcn charts) for any analytics visualizations in the Founder/Admin dashboard.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and links.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-md) with hover lift.
NEVER use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Create depth through layered design elements and 1px crisp borders.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Padding in cards should be p-6 or p-8.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Never use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided image_urls.
